author: sjm41
body:
* **ARBA rule (ID and label):**
ARBA00027723

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Dmel Qtzl (Q8IPA0)

* **Description of issue**
Qtzl is a chimeric gene that "does not, contain any known enzyme active sites or binding domains from either parental gene." (PMID: [20534482](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20534482/))

however, ARBA00027723 annotates it with 'transferase activity' [GO:0016740](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/term/GO:0016740), I think based on this rule:
 "IPR000192 & IPR015422 in Hexapoda" 

Could the rule be revised or Qtzl annotated to prevent this?
(I have just add a 'NOT transferase activity IKR' annotation in P2GO based on PMID:20534482)

Thanks.
title: ARBA2GO issue: ARBA00027723
